jannisteunissen/rng_fortran.manifest:
name = "rng-fortran"
version = "0.0.0"
license = "GPL-3.0"
[library]
source-dir = "playground-library"
[build]
auto-executables = false
auto-examples = false
auto-tests = false
[install]
library = true

scope: Xoroshiro128+ pseudo-random generator. An FPM wrapper selects unchanged m_random.f90 and uses -fwrapv for its intentional signed-integer wraparound. Two fresh generators replay 10000 seeded uniform draws exactly; the main checks the implementation range [0,1), broad uniform/normal/Poisson(4) moment tolerances, nonnegative counts and unit circle/sphere norms. These are deterministic smoke checks, not statistical quality or cryptographic validation. OpenMP, jump independence, large Poisson rates and all distributions are not covered. A separate hosted reproducer confirms that set_seed does not clear the cached second normal after an odd normal() call; use a fresh generator to restart normal sequences. The selected replay uses fresh objects.

source_packaging.note: Only the listed unchanged library files are copied into playground-library; upstream test/program files are excluded.

known_limitations: set_seed does not discard the cached second normal after an odd normal() call. Restart normal streams with a fresh generator.
